verdict.rationale: Docs describe users giving Marlin a natural-language research topic and a brief clarifying exchange to set direction, after which it runs autonomously — this supports natural-language initiation but not broader natural-language control during execution. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands beyond initial topic-setting (e.g., mid-run steering, chat-style follow-up queries), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the interaction style.
